args.content:
## Hawaii Packing List

**Essentials**
• Passport
• Driver's license
• Travel insurance
• Credit cards
• Debit card
• Cash

**Clothing**
• 3-4 tops
• 2-3 pairs shorts
• 1-2 swimsuits
• 1 light jacket
• 1 pair comfortable walking shoes
• 1 pair sandals
• Socks
• Underwear
• Dressier outfit for evening events

**Beach Essentials**
• Sunscreen
• Sunglasses
• Beach towel
• Snorkeling gear
• Water shoes
• Beach bag

**Electronics**
• Smartphone
• Portable charger
• Camera
• Power bank
• Universal power adapter
• Waterproof phone case

**Medications**
• Prescription medications
• Over-the-counter pain relievers
• Antihistamines
• Motion sickness medication
• Seasickness bands

**Travel Documents**
• Flight itinerary
• Hotel reservation
• Rental car info
• Travel insurance documents
• Driver's license

**Miscellaneous**
• Reusable water bottle
• Collapsible umbrella
• Reef-safe sunscreen
• Beach reading
• Snorkeling bag
• Waterproof phone case
• Travel-size essentials
• Adapters
• Power strip
• Earplugs
• Eye mask

**Packing Tips**
• Pack light
• Use packing cubes
• Roll clothes
• Wear heaviest items
• Leave space for souvenirs

**Notes**
• Check weather forecast before departure
• Pack accordingly
• Consider packing a small daypack for daily excursions
• Bring a small first-aid kit
• Don't forget sunscreen
• Bring a water bottle
• Pack a small portable charger
• Bring a light jacket for cooler evenings
• Consider packing a small backpack for island hopping

Created from vacation-planning documentation for Hawaii trip
